rules.title: request is deprecated
rules.summary: The package is fully deprecated and no new changes are expected.
rules.replacement: Native fetch or a maintained HTTP client

constraints: Preserve request method, headers, authentication, redirects, timeouts, retries, proxy behavior, streaming, and response/error semantics used by each call site.

steps.title: Choose the target HTTP client
steps.instructions: Select native fetch or one maintained client whose behavior covers the affected request usages.

steps.title: Rewrite request usages
steps.instructions: Translate callbacks, options, response handling, errors, and streams at every reported import and call.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove request from package metadata and add the selected maintained client only if native fetch is insufficient.

verification.purpose: Run HTTP behavior and repository tests when defined.
Verify imports, types, and the build remain valid.

steps.title: Plan the Nuxt 3 upgrade
steps.instructions: Follow the Nuxt 3 migration guidance for build modules and TypeScript configuration before removing the module.

steps.title: Drop the TypeScript build module
steps.instructions: Remove @nuxt/typescript-build from buildModules and the project dependencies; Nuxt 3 compiles and type-checks TypeScript without a build module.

verification.purpose: Build the Nuxt 3 application with its built-in TypeScript support.
Run the application and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: react-beautiful-dnd is deprecated
rules.summary: npm marks react-beautiful-dnd as deprecated: "react-beautiful-dnd is now deprecated. Context and options: https://github.com/atlassian/react-beautiful-dnd/issues/2672"
rules.replacement: Pragmatic drag and drop, dnd-kit, or a maintained fork

constraints: Preserve drag behavior, keyboard and screen-reader support, droppable ids, and the rendered structure each screen depends on.

steps.title: Choose the replacement
steps.instructions: Pick Pragmatic drag and drop, its react-beautiful-dnd migration package, dnd-kit, or a maintained fork based on the behaviors each screen uses.

steps.title: Migrate the drag-and-drop components
steps.instructions: Rewrite DragDropContext, Droppable, and Draggable usages for the replacement, keeping droppable ids stable where persisted state refers to them.

verification.purpose: Run drag-and-drop interaction and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: rollup-plugin-terser is deprecated
rules.summary: npm marks rollup-plugin-terser as deprecated: "This package has been deprecated and is no longer maintained. Please use @rollup/plugin-terser"

constraints: Preserve minification options, source maps, and the assets each Rollup build emits.

steps.title: Replace the Rollup Terser plugin
steps.instructions: Replace rollup-plugin-terser with @rollup/plugin-terser in dependencies and the Rollup configuration, and keep the current terser options.

steps.title: Verify bundle output
steps.instructions: Compare size, source maps, and runtime behavior of every minified output with the previous build.

verification.purpose: Build every Rollup output with the maintained Terser plugin.

rules.title: socket.io-redis is deprecated
rules.summary: npm marks socket.io-redis as deprecated: "This package has been renamed to '@socket.io/redis-adapter', please see the migration guide here: https://socket.io/docs/v4/redis-adapter/#migrating-from-socketio-redis"

constraints: Preserve adapter behavior: pub/sub and request/response channels, key prefixes, and multi-node session routing.

steps.title: Replace the adapter package
steps.instructions: Replace socket.io-redis with @socket.io/redis-adapter and follow the published migration guide for the adapter options.

steps.title: Verify multi-node behavior
steps.instructions: Connect clients through more than one server instance and confirm broadcasts, rooms, and acknowledgements still work.

verification.purpose: Run the realtime and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: @types/diff is deprecated
rules.summary: npm marks @types/diff as deprecated: "This is a stub types definition. diff provides its own type definitions, so you do not need this installed."

constraints: @types/diff only declares types; diff now ships its own declarations, so no conflicting ambient definition may remain.

steps.title: Remove the stub types package
steps.instructions: Remove @types/diff from devDependencies and any explicit reference to it, such as a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.types entry.

steps.title: Use the bundled declarations
steps.instructions: Keep diff on a version that ships its own type definitions and import its types from diff.

verification.purpose: Type-check and build with diff's own declarations.
Run the repository tests when defined.
